rows.en: ...Those three things, the materials and the armament, are our objectives.
Normally, we'd have had no choice but to hit these three sites one at a time, but
this time, with the Hero Team backing us up, we can move on all of them at once.
That way, the enemy will have to split up its forces. Then Celestial Being will act as a decoy...
and draw the enemy's attention.
Meanwhile, the Hero Team will push into the designated points and seize the materials.
That's the operation plan.
Understood.
So all we have to do is infiltrate the designated points and recover the materials you've specified?
That's right.
We've assigned Celestial Being's members to each of the operation zones.
Operation A, "Emerium ore recovery," is assigned to Cherudim and Arios.
Operation B, "Gundanium alloy recovery," goes to Deathscythe Hell and Kamen Rider Birth.
Operation C, "Armory raid," is assigned to Sandrock and Heavyarms.
All of these operation zones are concentrated in Area 3.
Each of them will be standing by on-site, so talk to them when you're ready to start the operation.
You can start with whichever operation you like.
Next, about Wing Zero and 00...
Both of them excel at infiltration missions.
Wing Zero, I want you to stay with the Hero Team. 00, you'll join them starting now.
Mission accepted.
Understood. Commencing infiltration.
Don't screw it up!
Still, the enemy's tough in every one of these operation zones.
Mobile doll systems, GN Drive Taus, psycommu...
The enemy has seized all the cutting-edge tech from our home worlds and made it their strength.
Every last one of 'em is gonna be a tough nut to crack, huh.
Looks like this is gonna be one hell of a hard fight.
If we all work together, I'm sure it'll go well. We've got the Hero Team with us this time, after all.
Yeah. Somehow, I'm kinda starting to feel the same way.
All right! Then let's begin the operation!
Everyone, head to your assigned operation zones!
Hikari and I will stay at camp and take command. If you have any questions, come talk to us.
00 Gundam joined the party!
The heroes each hurriedly began preparing for the operation...
...Mebius.
I want you to have this.
This is... the "Knight Brace"!
It's sure to prove useful when the battle to come arrives.
But Hikari, what about you...!?
I've decided to focus on rear support as an engineer, so the rest of you can fight without worry.
Hikari...
Our current operation plan is "Recover the materials needed to complete the Ride Machine."
There are three operation zones.
Operation Zone A, "Emerium ore recovery," is assigned to Cherudim and Arios.
Operation Zone B, "Gundanium alloy recovery," is assigned to Deathscythe Hell and Birth.
Operation Zone C, "Armory raid," is assigned to Sandrock and Heavyarms.
All of these operation zones are concentrated in the "Wasteland Zone."
Each of them will be standing by on-site, so talk to them when you're ready to start the operation.
You can start with whichever operation you like.
Once you've recovered the materials, bring them to me.
I'll be waiting right here.
Have you recovered the materials we need?
Oh, the "Emerium ore"!
With this, the Ride Machine's energy supply should jump by orders of magnitude.
How is it? Is the operation going smoothly?
All that's left is the "Gundanium alloy" and the "weapons." Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
Is everything going to plan?
All that's left is the "Gundanium alloy." Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
I know it's a hard fight, but just one more push.
All that's left is "weapons" fit for the Ride Machine. Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
Oh, the "Gundanium alloy"!
With this, the Ride Machine's armor should be vastly reinforced.
How is it? Is the operation going smoothly?
All that's left is the "Emerium ore" and the "weapons." Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
Is everything going to plan?
All that's left is the "Emerium ore." Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
I know it's a hard fight, but just one more push.
All that's left is "weapons" fit for the Ride Machine. Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
Oh, this is... the "Gaia Cannon"!
I see... This would make a perfect main gun for the Ride Machine.
Is everything going to plan?
All that's left is the "Emerium ore" and the "Gundanium alloy."
Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
Is everything going to plan?
All that's left is the "Emerium ore." Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
I know it's a hard fight, but just one more push.
All that's left is the "Gundanium alloy." Keep it up. I'm counting on you.
I see... Once you've recovered them, bring them here.
...That's everything, then. All right, let's get to work right away.

notes.note: Rows 0228.48-0.91 are a legacy variant of the 0227 briefing (story_028). Mis-decoded kanji inferred from the matching 0227 lines: 0.50 'with the Hero Team's help' / 'proceed at once', 0.63 'concentrated', 0.74 'GN Drive Tau' (pseudo-solar furnace), 0.75 'seized/taken control of', 0.76 'tough nut to crack'.

Speaker labels in this legacy table look mis-mapped: per the 0227 version, 'Rider 1' lines belong to Seravee/Cherudim, 'OOO' to Heavyarms, 'W (Shotaro)' to Deathscythe Hell, 'Ultraman' to Sandrock, 'Black RX' to Cherudim. Lines voiced to suit the 0227 speakers (which also fit the labels' register). Speaker-label fields need checking by the orchestrator.

Operation names in source quote brackets; rendered as quoted lowercase task names using glossary 'Emerium ore' / 'Gundanium alloy'. This legacy variant names Cherudim in the third person (0227 has 'me and Arios'); kept as written.
Legacy variant says 'Area 3'; the 0229 version says 'Wasteland Zone' (area name, not in glossary; modelled on story_025's 'Quicksand Zone'). Both kept as written.
Row ends mid-sentence ('as for Wing Zero and 00, ...'); cut as 'Next, about Wing Zero and 00...' so 0.67 continues it.
Source runs 'Roger' and 'begin infiltration' together (missing line break); rendered as two sentences in 00's terse voice.
Double negative 'it's not that I don't feel that way' rendered 'I'm kinda starting to feel the same way'.
Rows 0.85-0.91 unlabelled; per 0227.93-99 they alternate Hikari (0.85, 0.86, 0.88, 0.90) and Mebius (0.87, 0.89, 0.91).
Legacy variant says 'at the time of the coming battle'; 'when the battle to come arrives' keeps that nuance.
0230 rows unlabelled after 0.2; all are Hikari at camp taking delivery of the materials (branch variants by which items have been delivered).
'Busou' (armament) rendered 'weapons' in Hikari's checklist lines; the briefing rows use 'armament'. 'Hikitsuzuki tanonda zo' = Hikari asking the party: 'Keep it up. I'm counting on you.'
Source says 'Gundanium ore' here, a slip for 'Gundanium alloy'; rendered as the glossary item name 'Gundanium alloy'.
'Sagyou ni torikakarou' read as inclusive 'let's get to work' (Hikari plus the other engineers), matching next slice's crew-wide work montage.

report: 80/80 rows. Legacy 0228.48-0.91 is a variant of 0227's briefing; mis-decoded kanji (0.50, 0.63, 0.74, 0.75, 0.76) inferred from 0227. Speaker labels in that legacy block look mis-mapped (Rider 1/OOO/W/Ultraman/Black RX vs Seravee/Cherudim/Heavyarms/Deathscythe Hell/Sandrock in 0227). 0230.35 'Gundanium ore' source slip rendered 'alloy'. Not in glossary: GN Drive Tau, psycommu, Wasteland Zone (area), Area 3.
